name: Progress Indicator
structurePatterns: linear: a pill track with a fill from 0% to the determinate value
circular: an SVG ring with a partial arc (stroke-dasharray) representing progress, 24px
optional value label shown to the right (linear) or centered (circular)
usageHints: only show truthful determinate progress; use Loading Indicator for indeterminate work
accent cyan requires an explicit product decision — default indicator is brand primary
determinate value must be exposed to accessibility
doNotInvent: no indeterminate animation masquerading as determinate
